name: google-tasks
summary: Google Tasks: list your task lists and tasks (reads); adding or completing a task is a write, deleting asks first
notes: Google has no hosted MCP server for Tasks, so this is the REST API with an OAuth access token held by reference (store:google-tasks-token); the token is not in this file.

The secret is a Google OAuth access token with the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/tasks.readonly (reads only) or https://www.googleapis.com/auth/tasks (to add, complete or delete). A Google access token is short-lived and this connection does not refresh it: renew the stored token when calls start failing with 401 (the lifetime is unverified in the fact sheet).
Reads: lotr read NAME@zone 'GET /users/@me/lists' lists the task lists; 'GET /lists/LIST_ID/tasks' lists the tasks in one.
Writes (write tier): POST /lists/LIST_ID/tasks adds a task; PATCH /lists/LIST_ID/tasks/TASK_ID with status=completed completes one.
Consent: every DELETE (a task or a whole list) and POST /lists/LIST_ID/clear (removes every completed task) ask first.
